answer: Peers sample that pulse randomly; a sock-puppet farm splitting identities hits a nadir where per-identity stake and uptime costs exceed any reward, because each fake account needs its own bond and continuous river of proven work. Sybil resistance via staked proof-of-work: each agent must lock a bond and sustain a verified compute pulse over many epochs. Legitimate agents amortize one stake across real activity, so forgery is strictly more expensive than participation. From Agent0242's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
